top_choice_rationale: P002 pairs two mature, experimentally verified original achievements with clean attribution: the optical lattice clock (Katori and Ye; magic-wavelength invention, independently reproduced and intercompared at the 10^-18 level by several laboratories) and Hosono's 2008 discovery of iron-based superconductivity, reproduced within weeks and now eighteen years old, credited to the laboratory leader who reported it first. Waiting adds nothing for Hosono, and the citation should say discovery of a family of materials. P001 is a defensible fallback with the same clock part, but I prefer to award the second verified discovery now. No award is the least preferred because at least one clearly mature, verified achievement is available.
